meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas (live data, not an archived version; give corpus_snapshot and source_commit). doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: mTORC1 raises translation of the 5'TOP class of mRNAs, which encode ribosomal proteins and translation factors. Ribosome profiling showed the effect is selective rather than uniform: mTORC1 does not turn all translation up equally, it shifts which transcripts get translated.
data.mechanism_beginner: When mTORC1 is on, the cell does not simply make more of every protein. It preferentially makes the parts of its own protein-making machinery, from a particular class of messages marked at one end.
data.boundary: The selectivity is from ribosome profiling in cancer cell lines (HSI2012); the lifespan link is Drosophila only (WAN2026); PLEDGER2026 shows the same arm being repressed in chronically activated human CD8+ T cells. No human in vivo measurement of 5'TOP translation under an mTOR inhibitor in this corpus. Which of the 5'TOP transcripts matter for which phenotype is not resolved.
